title: Several 'settle the dispute between companions' will checks had quietly escalating DCs and no visible bonus preview before committing, leading to failed attempts that cost standing with two companions at once despite reasonably high will scores.
where: various companion dispute prompts (e.g. Tamsin/Osk, Tamsin/Vell)
